_note: DOC 2 Appendix A verified figures — public sources only. Unverified items use null. Curated geo (D5) and RBI distributions (R2) will swap in on arrival.
_sources: MHA Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 1906, 11 March 2025 — state-wise cybercrime complaints
NCRB 2024 annual report — Cyber Crime cases and amounts reported
RBI notifications on ATM daily withdrawal limits (bank-specific, no universal cap)
I4C/MHA press release 2025 — national cybercrime complaint volume

complaints_per_day.source: I4C 2025 average derived from annual total ~24.1 lakh / 365
complaints_per_day.note: Range 6500–8000 cited; golden uses 600 for district-scale slice

mean_inr.source: NCRB 2024 / CERT-In — weighted average ₹94,000 (2025 figure); ₹1.19 lakh (2024)
mean_inr.note: Heavy-tailed shape is our assumption; not an official distribution

state_weights.source: data/seed/state_cybercrime_weights.csv — MHA Rajya Sabha USQ 1200 (30.07.2025), NCRP 2024 incident counts, normalised to four demo states
state_weights.note: Curated geo (D5) swapped in on arrival, as this file's own top-level note anticipated. Weights complaint origin, not cash-out location. Demo states are now UP/MH/HR/JH (JH replaces RJ — the curated data only covers these four).

card_atm_daily_inr.source: Bank-specific published limits; no universal RBI cap for debit ATM

cardless_atm_txn_inr.source: RBI/Bank notifications on cardless ATM transaction limits

aeps_txn_inr.source: NPCI AEPS guidelines — bank-specific; range typically 10,000–50,000/day

timing.note: No public time-to-withdrawal distribution exists (fewer than 8 numeric observations found — R2). Values below are priors only.

fast_median_min.source: Assumed from scattered case reports; SWEEP 15 / 60 / 240 min
